content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To become more than friends with another friend if you are bisexual, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Suggest a low-pressure one-on-one hangout (2 hours)
Step 2. Research local LGBTQ+ friendly cafes (30 minutes)
Step 3. Share a personal story about your identity (15 minutes)
Step 4. Express your feelings clearly (10 minutes)
Step 5. Plan a formal first date (1 hour)
Step 6. Discuss your mutual future expectations (1 hour)
Step 7. Reflect on your own emotional readiness (3 days)
Step 8. Check in on their current relationship status (15 minutes)
Step 9. Gauge their reaction to queer topics (20 minutes)
Step 10. Confirm the time for your next meetup (5 minutes)
Step 11. Select a thoughtful small gift (45 minutes)
Step 12. Host a small group game night to see your chemistry (4 hours)
Step 13. Send a follow-up text after a deep conversation (5 minutes)
Step 14. Practice self-affirmations in the mirror (10 minutes)
Step 15. Buy a new outfit for a special outing (2 hours)
Step 16. Ask about their ideal partner qualities (30 minutes)
Step 17. Look for subtle physical cues like prolonged eye contact (1 day)
Step 18. Share a playlist of songs that remind you of them (1 hour)
Step 19. Identify shared hobbies you both enjoy (30 minutes)
Step 20. Offer a sincere compliment on their personality (5 minutes)
Step 21. Mention a bisexual public figure you admire (10 minutes)
Step 22. Establish a regular "check-in" habit (1 week)
Step 23. Bring them their favorite coffee or snack (15 minutes)
Step 24. Invite them to a pride event (4 hours)
Step 25. Create a shared digital photo album (20 minutes)
Step 26. Define the relationship boundaries (1 hour)
Step 27. Meet each other's close friends (3 hours)
Step 28. Ask them how they feel about the LGBTQ+ community (30 minutes)
Step 29. Journal about your specific fears regarding the friendship (1 hour)
Step 30. Agree to move forward as a couple (1 hour)
Step 31. Watch a romantic movie together (2 hours)
Step 32. Increase the frequency of your text messages (2 days)
Step 33. Offer emotional support during a stressful day (3 hours)
Step 34. Go for a long walk in a local park (90 minutes)
Step 35. Read a book on healthy communication (5 days)
Step 36. Bake a treat to share with them (2 hours)
Step 37. Analyze your compatibility regarding lifestyle (2 days)
Step 38. Initiate a conversation about your "crush" history (45 minutes)
Step 39. Ask if they have ever considered dating a friend (20 minutes)
Step 40. Discuss your favorite queer-coded media (1 hour)
Step 41. Write a heartfelt letter you may or may not send (1 hour)
Step 42. Hold hands for the first time (5 minutes)
Step 43. Spend a full weekend together (2 days)
Step 44. Meditate on your attraction (20 minutes)
Step 45. Ask for their opinion on a personal project (30 minutes)
Step 46. Give them a long, meaningful hug (1 minute)
Step 47. Attend a workshop on inclusive dating (3 hours)
Step 48. Listen to a podcast about bisexual experiences (1 hour)
Step 49. Introduce them to your favorite local spot (2 hours)
Step 50. Work on your self-confidence (1 week)
Step 51. Have a "first kiss" conversation (30 minutes)
Step 52. Share a secret you've never told anyone else (20 minutes)
Step 53. Cook a meal together at home (2 hours)
Step 54. Delete your dating apps (15 minutes)
Step 55. Work through any internalized biphobia (2 weeks)
Step 56. Attend a social gathering as their "plus one" (4 hours)
Step 57. Exchange house keys (5 minutes)
Step 58. Discuss how your bisexuality impacts your dating life (1 hour)
Step 59. Update your social media relationship status (10 minutes)
Step 60. Tell them "I like you as more than a friend" (5 minutes)
Step 61. Browse an art gallery together (2 hours)
Step 62. Plan a vacation together (3 days)
Step 63. Buy tickets to a concert (20 minutes)
Step 64. Send them a funny meme every morning (1 minute)
Step 65. Take a personality test together (30 minutes)
Step 66. Ask a mutual friend for advice (1 hour)
Step 67. Cuddle on the couch (1 hour)
Step 68. Reflect on your previous relationship patterns (4 hours)
Step 69. Compliment their style or appearance (5 minutes)
Step 70. Evaluate if you can handle a potential rejection (1 day)
Step 71. Ask about their childhood memories (2 hours)
Step 72. Go on a "trial" date (3 hours)
Step 73. Discuss long-term life goals (2 hours)
Step 74. Create a "bucket list" of things to do together (1 hour)
Step 75. Discuss sexual health and boundaries (1 hour)
Step 76. Buy a bouquet of their favorite flowers (20 minutes)
Step 77. Introduce them to your family (4 hours)
Step 78. Listen to their favorite album (1 hour)
Step 79. Share your "coming out" story (30 minutes)
Step 80. Look at old photos of each other (1 hour)
